trap.label: make + to
trap.wrong: Dark pavements make the heat to increase.
trap.right: Dark pavements make the heat increase.
trap.why: Em português “fazem o calor aumentar” corresponde a uma estrutura com infinitivo. Em inglês, make + objeto + verbo na forma base, sem to.

mcq.why: Let me define… abre o tema.

opts: Wind blockage makes cities get hotter.
Wind blockage makes cities to get hotter.
Wind blockage makes cities getting hotter.

fix.wrong: Heat makes people to feel tired.

rewrite.prompt: Reescreva com make: “Dark roofs cause the city to get hotter.”
rewrite.answer: Dark roofs make the city get hotter.

rewrite.prompt: Reescreva com which means: “Surface temperature rises. The result is more energy use.” (…, which means more energy use)
rewrite.answer: Surface temperature rises, which means more energy use.

rewrite.prompt: Reescreva no passado: “Dark pavements make the heat increase.”
rewrite.answer: Dark pavements made the heat increase.
